Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Linux Audit提供核心與使用者空間稽核事件；一個事件可由多筆紀錄組成。
knowledge.textEn: Linux Audit provides kernel/userspace audit events, with one event potentially spanning multiple records.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以合成SYSCALL、PATH與CWD紀錄依事件序號與來源主機組裝；分開定義record數、event數與實際操作數，保留lost/backlog狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Assemble synthetic SYSCALL, PATH and CWD records by event serial and host; distinguish record, event and operation counts and retain lost/backlog state.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 完整事件率=具所有所需紀錄的事件/預期事件；不能拿稽核行數直接當操作數，多筆紀錄不代表多次操作。
knowledge.textEn: Complete-event rate equals events with all required records divided by expected events; log-line count is not operation count because events span records.
